## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:记录整页、右侧预览和手机记录页上,记录名右边多了一颗星。空心表示没收藏,点一下变实心并进左侧栏「收藏」,再点一下取消。「更多」里不再有「添加到收藏」。
- 为什么做:卡 #36246。按「以 attio 为准」,把收藏入口从「更多」挪到记录名旁边。
- 出错会怎样:用户看不到星标,或点了没反应;已有的收藏数据和左侧栏不受影响。可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,共 1 项。spec 里一句已发布的说明被本 PR 改成了错的,要在这里一起改。代码、测试、截图和宽度的说明我读下来都对。

## 要改的(1 项)

1. **spec 里退役 `showStar` 的说明被本 PR 改成了错的。** `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:819-823` 是 `retiredKey` 的拒绝文字,作者写了 `showStar` 就会收到这句话。它写的是:「the reference console draws no star beside the record title … the record's favorites entry is the header's ⋯ menu … the ⋯ menu's favorites entry is unchanged」。本 PR 之后,控制台在记录名旁边画了星,「⋯」里也没有收藏入口了,所以这三处说法都不再成立。生成的 `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx:1580` 也是这句话。spec 发运 `src/**/*.zod.ts`,按清单,本轮令其变假的已发布缺陷要在本 PR 里修。
   - 退役本身不受影响:星标仍然只在宿主接了收藏开关时才画,和元数据无关,所以这个键「什么也不控制」这一点依然成立。只需改说法,例如「the console draws the record's star from the host's favorites toggle, never from metadata, so the key switched nothing」,并去掉「⋯ menu」那两处。
   - 要一起动的地方:`packages/spec/src/ui/page-header-show-star-retirement.test.ts:61` 的 `PRESCRIPTION` 正则钉了原文;重新生成 `component.mdx`;再加一条 `@objectstack/spec` 的 patch changeset。只改文字,`Clause-②: no` 和 `Metadata-protocol: none` 不变。
   - 不要求改:`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template:2666-2670` 的 D3 条目说的是 18 版退役时的情况,属于历史记录;`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` 的旧条目也是。要不要给 D3 条目加一句「自 #36246 起控制台在名字旁画星」,由区域定。

## 席位核对

- **卡片关系**:首行 `Fixes #36246`。卡上 1 到 4 项都交付了:名字旁的星一直可见、点一下切换;「⋯」里的入口拿掉;整页、预览、手机三处都有;收藏数据和侧栏不变。合并应当关卡。`l1-face` 没有标旗。
- **验收**:HotCRM 线索的前后截图都附了(1440 和 800)。宽度那一条按实测说明,席位采用读法 A,正文写明了。「自建应用客户」改用 HotCRM 的客户对象,正文写明了原因。
- **声明**:`Clause-②: no` 对。没有新导出的 prop,`RecordContextProvider` 的 `isFavorite` / `onToggleFavorite` 原本就有,本 PR 只是接上。`Metadata-protocol: none` 对。不欠 Skills-docs。不是 `!`,也没有 `(narrowing)`,不欠 dogfood。
- **changeset**:`@object-ui/app-shell`(private)和 `@object-ui/components` 都有 patch 条目。逐句核过:星标在三处画、空心和实心、点一下切换、「⋯」没有收藏入口、手机 44px 点击区域、打印页保留入口,都和 `RecordDetailView.tsx` 里 `pageDeclaresPrintOf(assignedPage)` 的判断以及 `RecordTitleChip.tsx` 的 className 一致。加了第 1 项之后,还要再加 spec 的条目。
- **打印页**:`pageDeclaresPrintOf` 是从原来的内联判断抽出来的,打印外框读的仍然是 `renderedPage`,行为不变。`printPageHeaderActions-12906` 没改,仍然是绿的。
- **测试**:`favoritesEntry-12427` 的第一个 `describe` 是有意重写的,因为它原来钉的是 objectui#12427 的相反位置,维护者的裁定把它推翻了,正文写明了。三处入口、重新加载、手机都覆盖到了,带分享和底栏两个对照。两处消融(去掉 `onToggleFavorite`、把判断改回 `if (favoriteRecord)`)都会让对应用例变红,复原后 diff 为空。
- **与 #36438 的关系**:两个 PR 都改 `RecordDetailView.tsx`,但改的地方不重叠。#36438 在预览里给名字包了一层带全名提示的 `span`,星标由 `RecordTitleChip` 画在这层外面。合并顺序不影响结果,后合并的那个需要先合入 main。
- **CI @ `b6db6ed6`**:47 success、15 skipped、0 failed;mergeable clean;非受管。

### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`  _(via showStar (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via PageHeaderProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`  _(via showStar (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **250** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 39e9a820fc57b5febd990a184194503b5687ad99` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `518b844184753b09e21440d5401d46603aa114fd` — the merge of head `646a72bba3c9a3c56add3acb793a9015ddf7a12a` into base `39e9a820fc57b5febd990a184194503b5687ad99`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 518b844184753b09e21440d5401d46603aa114fd && git checkout 518b844184753b09e21440d5401d46603aa114fd
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 39e9a820fc57b5febd990a184194503b5687ad99 646a72bba3c9a3c56add3acb793a9015ddf7a12a && git checkout -B drift-repro 39e9a820fc57b5febd990a184194503b5687ad99 && git merge --no-ff 646a72bba3c9a3c56add3acb793a9015ddf7a12a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 39e9a820fc57b5febd990a184194503b5687ad99
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 39e9a820fc57b5febd990a184194503b5687ad99` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `646a72bba3c9a3c56add3acb793a9015ddf7a12a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/page-header-show-star-retirement.test.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/custom/RecordTitleChip.tsx

Inputs read: card #36246 body and all 5 comments, PR #36456 body, file list (10 files) and net diff against `main`, PR comments 7079405734, 7079464577 (L1 REWORK), 7080267247, and the check-runs on this head (63 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed). The rest of the diff (the three UI test files, the changeset prose, the regenerated `component.mdx`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set of `PageHeaderProps`: unchanged, right. `showStar` stays a `retiredKey` tombstone in the same `strictObject`; `true`, `false` and a non-boolean are refused exactly as on `main`. Only the refusal message and two jsdoc paragraphs change. `Spec property liveness`, `Type Check` and `Test Core` are green on the head.
- Public surface of `@objectstack/spec`: one published string changes (the refusal an author receives from `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint`), and the generated reference row in `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` follows it word for word. No export, type or key is added or removed. Right.
- Public surface of the UI packages: no exported prop or i18n key is added. `RecordContextProvider` already took `isFavorite` and `onToggleFavorite`; the PR wires them. `RecordTitleChip` changes a class string only. Right.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: right, no protocol major, conversion or registered key moves.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec` patch: right for a wording-only change to a refusal message with the accept-set unchanged.
- `@object-ui/components` patch and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch: no published API changes; the level is the lane seat's to accept and `Check Changeset` is green.
- Clause-②: no. Agrees with the diff: nothing an author could write before is refused now, and nothing new is accepted.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question, record name width (round 1): the seat ruled A on the card thread and the PR body states the measured reading. It is a UI layout reading with no contract face; answered.
- Dev flag, `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts` outside the rework list: right to update, it pinned the old phrase and would have gone red. The new `toContain` string is a literal substring of the new refusal.
- Dev flag, old wording left in the 18 conversion summary and in the retired-keys entry comment as history: half right. See S1 for the conversion summary; the retired-keys entry comment and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` are source history and are right to leave.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join; the star reads the favorite state the view already computed.
- No security flag raised by the dev; none found in the reviewed files.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (hits file), read against the renderer on `main` (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, the comment and code at the `disableRecordChromeOf` call) and against the two source files in this diff:

- The new refusal says the console draws the record's star from the host's favorites toggle, never from metadata. Holds: the renderer draws the star only where the record context carries `onToggleFavorite` and no longer reads `showStar`; `RecordDetailView.tsx` now passes `onToggleFavorite` whenever `favoriteRecord` exists.
- "Delete the key, whether it was `true` or `false`; the page draws the same star without it." Holds for both values and for a page with `recordChrome: false` or a print page (no chip, so no star with or without the key).
- The `recordChrome` jsdoc ("as the reference console does on its record pages") and the `showStar` jsdoc (no reference host wired it at retirement; since #36246 the console does) both hold against the diff.
- The tombstone stays the same `retiredKey` call and still ends with the `os migrate meta --from 17` prescription, which the `PRESCRIPTION` regex pins.

S1 (should-fix): the refusal now contradicts the text it sends the author to. The tombstone ends with "Run `os migrate meta --from 17`", and that command prints, from `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-header-show-star-retired.ts`, the replacement "The record's favorites entry is the header's ⋯ menu", the reason "the console wires none", and the `verify:` line "the record's favorites entry is still in the header's ⋯ menu" (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`, `printNotice`). The conversion `summary` in `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/18/page-header-show-star-removed.ts` ("the reference console draws no star beside the record title: the record's favorites entry is the header's ⋯ menu") is projected into the shipped `spec-changes.json` by `composeSpecChanges` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/spec-changes.ts`). These are not history: they are present-tense strings shown to anyone upgrading from 17 to the release that carries this PR, and the `verify:` line now fails on a correct upgrade (the console shows a star and the ⋯ holds no favorites entry). It is the same class of defect the L1 REWORK named for the refusal, made false by this PR. Fix in this PR: reword the conversion summary and the D3 entry's `replacement`, `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria` to the host-toggle wording (and the matching D3 sentence in `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` if the generated registry carries it), then regenerate. If the area holds released registry entries frozen, say so on the thread with the rule, and the seat rules.

Implementing files:

- `packages/spec/src/ui/page-header-show-star-retirement.test.ts`: the `PRESCRIPTION` regex matches the new message sentence by sentence (opening clause, "Delete the key" clause, the migrate clause). Agrees. Nit: its file-header comment still describes the pre-#36246 console; it is labelled "Measured before removal", so it reads as history. Leave.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts`: agrees with the new message; the comment above the case is updated to match.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: agrees with the contract sentence. `onToggleFavorite` is passed only when `favoriteRecord` exists, so the star and the stored favorite cannot diverge; `sys_favorite` is pushed only where `pageDeclaresPrintOf(assignedPage)` holds, which is the one face with no `page:header`, so no face holds two entries and none holds zero. `pageDeclaresPrintOf` is the old inline test extracted unchanged.
- `ui/packages/components/src/custom/RecordTitleChip.tsx`: class-only change, the copy-id button's phone target. No contract sentence depends on it.

Tried to break it: a host that wires no toggle (no star, refusal still true because it names the host's toggle as the switch); `showStar: false` on a console page (stripped or refused, star drawn either way, as the refusal says); a print page (no header, entry kept in the ⋯). None breaks the refusal text. Only S1 stands.
